Definition: Clients with a paid invoice in the last 90 days
Calculation: Count of unique Client ID where Status is Paid and Invoice date is in the 90 days up to the data-through date
Filters: Status is Paid; Invoice date in the last 90 days
Rows left out: Subtotal rows, duplicate invoices, test clients

Definition: Paid orders in the period, minus refunds issued in the period, in US dollars
Calculation: Sum of Amount where Status is Paid and Order date is in the period, minus sum of Refund amount where Refund date is in the period
Filters: Status is Paid; Order date or Refund date in the period
Rows left out: Totals row, blank amounts, test orders
Change note: Refunds now count in the period they are issued, not the period of the original order

Definition: Share of delivered orders that arrived by the promised date
Calculation: Orders with Delivered date on or before Promised date, divided by all orders with Delivered date in the period
Rows left out: Orders with no promised date, replacement shipments

Definition: Active projects whose latest status update is Green
Calculation: Count of active projects whose most recent status is Green, shown out of all active projects (for example 8 of 12)
Filters: Phase is not Closed; most recent status update per project
Rows left out: Older status updates for the same project
Change note: Amber no longer counts as on track

Definition: Median days from job posting to accepted offer, for roles filled in the period
Calculation: Median of Offer accepted date minus Posted date, for roles with Offer accepted date in the period
Filters: Offer accepted date in the period
Rows left out: Internal transfers, roles with no posted date
